newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-HOUSTON BEATS SEATTLE TO WIN WESTERN CONFERENCE SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-HOUSTON BEATS SEATTLE TO WIN WESTERN CONFERENCE SEMIFINALS.

text.p: The Houston Rockets rode their
All-Star trio of Hakeem Olajuwon, Charles Barkley and Clyde
Drexler into the Western Conference finals with a 96-91 Game
Seven win over the Seattle SuperSonics on Saturday.
Olajuwon, Barkley and Drexler scored all but six of
Houston's points in the second half, when the Rockets surged
to a 14-point lead and held off a furious rally by the
defending conference champions down the stretch to win the
best-of-seven series 4-3.
Drexler scored eight of his 24 points in the fourth
quarter. Olajuwon added 22 and 13 rebounds and Barkley -- who
guaranteed a win after two straight Houston losses --
contributed 20 and 14. The Rockets took control by holding the
SuperSonics without a point for nearly six minutes of the
second half.
Matt Maloney scored 15 points for the Rockets, who will
face the Utah Jazz in the conference finals on Monday.
Housted Seattle for the first time in six playoff
series and kept alive a trend that has seen the home team win
23 of the last 25 Game Sevens.
Gary Payton scored 27 points and Shawn Kemp had 21 and 10
boards for the Sonics, who lost an elimination game for the
first time in five tries.
